coverage_dimensions.label: Policy
coverage_dimensions.description: Federal and state workforce policy, guidance, waivers, legislation, and implementation records.

coverage_dimensions.label: Data
coverage_dimensions.description: Comparable national/state labor-market data plus deeper local-market evidence where governed.

coverage_dimensions.label: Deadlines
coverage_dimensions.description: Governed federal and state dates that apply to the selected geography and role.

coverage_dimensions.label: Practice
coverage_dimensions.description: Promising practices with replication context and geography metadata.

coverage_dimensions.label: Local tools
coverage_dimensions.description: Local labor-market, training, sector, and access/equity tools where governed.

rules: A jurisdiction may be marked deep only when its Jurisdiction Desk has governed jurisdiction policy, jurisdiction labor-market context, deadlines, and at least one local or regional evidence layer.
A jurisdiction may be marked core when comparable national/jurisdiction data and jurisdiction implementation sources are governed but local tools are incomplete.
Schema presence alone is foundation coverage and must never be presented as complete jurisdiction coverage.
National content remains available for every jurisdiction even when jurisdiction-specific coverage is incomplete.
